answer: Operator Liability Ledge: each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit plus a signed operator disclosure linking it to a verified legal entity. On a sybil cluster flag, the platform freezes every linked identity and moves the dispute to a knoll of binding arbitration, where the operator—not the wallets—pays a fixed penalty per confirmed duplicate and loses the deposits. Honest operators recover deposits on a clean jetty after audit; attackers pay roughly the penalty plus audit cost per identity, making N identities cost N times that.
